text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Alert -> multi-region-failover-monitor detected asymmetric traffic and elevated p99 latency. us-west1 serving 78% of regional traffic while us-east1 at 22%. Cross-region tail latency > 750ms and 5xx_rate approaching 2.8%. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/region-health/multi-region-overview

maria: ack. I'm on. Observed increased retransmits and TCP resets from front-proxy in us-west1. We might be seeing a hot-variant + capacity mismatch.

jules: adding context: a recent model rollout (float16-optim) landed in us-west1 yesterday; traffic steering stepped 10% -> 100% for that variant. Could be related.

ashwin: infra view: autoscaler in us-west1 saturated, pod OOMs reported for model-runner-7. Node pressure metrics show GPU_memory_alloc ~ 92% on older instance family.

linh: traces show spikes correlated to variant float16-optim for long-running generation sessions. Error signatures: upstream timeout at model-side (502 from model-fetch). Requests are queuing at frontend.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) immediate small failover: shift 25% of new sessions to us-central1 canary, 2) throttle traffic to float16-optim in us-west1 (set variant weight 30%), 3) temporarily increase pod replica target for model-runner-7 in us-west1, 4) open incident ticket.

kevin: executing failover step: `rctl traffic shift --from us-west1 --to us-central1 --percent 25 --strategy session_affinity`  Applying now.

devops-bot: Action accepted: traffic shift queued. Estimated propagation 15s.

jules: I'm rolling back the float16-optim rollout in us-west1 to previous weight. Command: `rctl route set --region us-west1 --model float16-optim --weight 30`

ashwin: scaling up: `kubectl scale deployment model-runner-7 -n prod --replicas=10` and provisioning new node types (p4d-like) in the pool. Draining older nodes.

linh: monitoring: p99 latency dropping after shift; error_rate trending down to 1.1% across us-west1. However replication lag for KV cache into us-central1 jumped, watching for staleness.

maria: good. Sam, can you gather quick list of customers with increased 5xx or latency? We'll need that for severity classification and comms.

sam: on it. Initial scan shows 7 affected orgs — 2 with visible SLA impact (chat product interruptions), 5 with elevated latency but degraded gracefully. I'll produce list and sample traces.

kevin: handoff note: once mitigated, owners should update the monitors: - multi-region-failover-monitor should include a gating condition: require cross-region imbalance > 50% AND p99>500ms for 10m. - add per-variant hotpath detector: if variant percent_by_region > 40% for 5m create non-pager alert. - add refractory: suppress repeat pages for 10m after autoscaler event.

maria: also add a metric gating on absolute error count to avoid pages from tiny services. Suggest error_count > 50 in 5m AND error_rate > 1.5% to page.

jules: ops improvement: add auto-suggest to runbook for safe isolation: `rctl route set --region <r> --model <m> --weight 0 && wait_for_health <r> <m> 60` and validate KV replication lag < 30s before full failover. Proposed to be implemented as a playbook step.

sre-runbook-bot: Playbook change requested: "Variant isolation with replication check". ID PB-4502. Requires dev-review.

kevin: dashboard follow-ups: create a multi-region panel that shows traffic fraction per model variant, replication lag per region, and failover override status. Linh, can you draft the panel queries?

linh: sample queries: `sum(rate(requests_total{job="front-proxy",region!="global"}[$__rate_interval])) by (region,variant)` and `max(disk_replication_lag_seconds) by (region)`; I'll build a heatmap + stacked area chart.

ashwin: infra follow-ups: autoscaler policy was conservative; need faster scale-up for GPU-heavy pods and better bin-packing to avoid leftover memory pressure on older nodes. I'll add recommended instance types and pre-warming notes to the ticket.

kevin: I created INC-2399 for this event and assigned follow-ups: TKT-7601 (monitor gating PR), TKT-7602 (dashboard panels), TKT-7603 (runbook playbook implementation), TKT-7604 (autoscaler tuning). Assigning to eng-sre, eng-runtime, eng-infra.

maria: customer comms: Sam, prepare a short update: what happened, who was impacted, what we did, ETA for full postmortem. Target: send to affected customers within 3 hours.

sam: will draft and share here in 90 min.

kevin: immediate alert tuning proposal (I'll PR): - multi-region imbalance alert: imbalance_ratio >= 0.5 for 10m AND regional_p99 > 500ms -> page. - add secondary non-paging alert for imbalance spikes shorter than 10m. - add variant-hotpath non-pager at 40% traffic for 5m, pager at 60% for 3m. - add refractory 10m for repeated pages tied to autoscaler or route changes.

maria: thanks. We'll review PR and test in staging. For closure: monitor for 2 hours post-change, then switch incident to mitigated.

pagerbot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> Sev3, incident_id INC-2399. Handoff @kevin for follow-ups.
